Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

The complete retained Home, Quality/Security, Annotation Platform, exact Agent Trajectory product2185 and English About texts were actually read. They explicitly offer paid datasets, customized multimodal collection/annotation/curation, client-rule output ranking/scoring for RLHF, red teaming, platform deployment, multiple inspection stages and specialist-team descriptions. These are provider statements and process descriptions, not independently verified credentials, certifications, efficiency increases, quality or buyer outcomes. Product2185 explicitly identifies 5,300 OpenClaw/Anthropic Claude Opus4.8-generated agent trajectories in English/Korean JSONL and a paid commercial-use offer; they are not human expert demonstrations. Full product payloads, screenshots and upstream model/output rights were not inspected, and the exact executed license remains unknown. The issuer p85/first-party Japanese brand bridge independently retained in the companion Datatang source-scope packet supports one proposed Datatang/Nexdata group, preserving original Nexdata identity and audit unit without a separate supplier count. Home catalogue names and the exact product/recommendations are preserved for family identity reconciliation; this scoped org admission does not close all datasets, sponsored datasets, news, events or competition functions. Five unchanged genuine three-role-reviewed facts remain exact; no new scientific PASS, new wording approval or deep credit is created here. Coordinator independently accepted the stated text/page/visual scopes and group identity. Retained operating-brand organization records are intentionally not counted as additional supplier groups.
